subject: Life Skills
title: Good Debt vs. Bad Debt
description: A short lesson to help you apply Good Debt vs. Bad Debt.

hook.text: A student loan funded a degree that tripled her salary. A car loan funded a depreciating SUV. Both are debt.

buildup.text: Good debt finances assets that grow in value or increase earning power: education, real estate, a business.

discovery.text: Bad debt finances things that lose value immediately: consumer electronics, vacations, clothing.

twist.text: Even 'good' debt turns bad at high interest rates. A 14% student loan is worse than a 4% one, no matter what it funded.

climax.text: Before borrowing, ask: will this make me money or lose me money over time? If the answer is lose, pay cash or wait.

punchline.text: Debt that builds wealth is a tool. The rest is a trap.

quiz.question: When does 'good debt' become bad?
options: When the debt amount exceeds your annual income
When the interest rate is high enough to erode the asset's value
Good debt never becomes bad debt
